svg.title: Jai Sai Siddhartha Peruri
svg.desc: Jai Sai Siddhartha Peruri, computer science, India. A hand sketches it. A model infers it. A grid computes it. A layout arranges it. An instrument measures it. From one place, they add up to a name. I study computer science and work in all five: drawing, models, code, interfaces, systems. Each name on the plates below is drawn only as far as its evidence goes: sketched, named with no code yet; inferred, built but not yet public; arranged, public but unfinished; measured, public and running.
